results.question: What should I bring on my first day and when will I get my ID card?
results.answer:
**Bring:** your completed personal‑details form (bank account, PAN/Aadhaar for India or I‑9 for US or Right‑to‑Work for UK), emergency‑contact and nominee information, and any documents required for background verification; you’ll also have a photo taken at reception for your ID card.  

**ID card:** will be ready within 3 working days of your start date; until then you’ll use a temporary visitor badge.  

- If your BGV documents are still pending, your start date (and thus the 3‑day ID‑card timeline) can be deferred [HR-ONB-001].  
- The temporary badge is issued at reception on day 1 and is valid until the official card arrives [ADM-001].
